description: Test helper functions and setup code for email package in Mattermost, including test environment setup, mock store configuration, and user/team/channel creation helpers.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: Helper struct for setting up and managing test environment, including user, team, channel creation, and configuration management.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, optionally with parallel store, and returns a TestHelper instance.

methods.name: SetupWithStoreMock
methods.description: Sets up test environment with a mocked store and status store, returns a TestHelper instance.

methods.name: setupTestHelper
methods.description: Internal function to initialize test helper with given store and testing object.

methods.name: InitBasic
methods.description: Initializes basic user, team, and channel setup within the test helper.

methods.name: CreateTeam
methods.description: Creates and saves a new team in the store.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates and saves a new channel within a team.

methods.name: addUserToChannel
methods.description: Adds a user to a channel as a member.

methods.name: addUserToTeam
methods.description: Adds a user to a team as a member.

methods.name: CreateUserOrGuest
methods.description: Creates a user or guest based on the parameter.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration with a provided function.

methods.name: ConfigureInbucketMail
methods.description: Configures email settings to use Inbucket SMTP server for testing.
